Description: UK retail proxy dataset may not generalise to Kenyan tax administration.
Mitigation / response: State proxy limitation; do not claim Kenyan compliance prediction; recommend future authorised local validation.

Description: Legitimate bulk orders, seasonality or returns may be flagged as anomalies.
Mitigation / response: Compare rule/statistical baselines; explain drivers; require human review; sample false positives.
Pseudonymise; restrict raw data; publish aggregates only; exclude raw data from Git.

Description: Proxy variables (country, customer activity, transaction value) may create uneven flag rates.
Mitigation / response: Compare observable groups; document proxy risk; avoid protected/sensitive predictors.

Description: Public UCI dataset remains accessible under the stated CC BY 4.0 licence.
Mitigation / response: Verify source page, version, attribution and download date before use.

Description: Local development environment can process a representative dataset sample.
Mitigation / response: Benchmark ingestion and processing; document hardware/software versions.

Description: No verified labels of tax non-compliance or fraud exist in the selected dataset.
Mitigation / response: Use unsupervised validation, case review and stability analysis; do not report supervised accuracy.

Description: CustomerID is missing for some transaction lines and cancellations need contextual treatment.
Mitigation / response: Profile missingness; preserve missing values; separately classify cancellation/return patterns.

Description: Dataset download and source/licence verification are prerequisites for pipeline development.
Mitigation / response: Record retrieval date, source filename, checksum and dataset version.

Description: Python environment and GitHub repository must be ready before sprint coding.
Mitigation / response: Commit requirements file, README, folder structure and .gitignore first.

Description: Power BI dashboard depends on validated feature and model output tables.
Mitigation / response: Define output schema during Sprint 2 and freeze dashboard fields before Sprint 4.
